about: A probability tree that grows branch by branch as each outcome is said, with the chance on every branch and each whole path's chance worked out by multiplying along it: two-stage chances, tests and false alarms, weather and plans, repeated draws.

first.about: first outcomes and their chances, as name:chance split by |

second.about: second outcomes under every first one, or one set per first outcome split by ;

highlight.about: one path to pick out, as First>Second

when.about: moments each first branch, then each second branch, grows; else when they are said, or one after another
